records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Works!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with first_project reached 2026-06-22, so there is real early momentum and 8 days left in the window. But no invites sent, no tickets, and no customer reply to welcome outreach [email:0cf5d85d], so engagement depth is unknown on a Starter plan.

draft.subject: Nice start on your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for getting your first project set up in Wrenfield last week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few tasks to that project is usually the natural next step.

When you're ready to bring in the rest of the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next for Quartz Works.

Best,
Chidi
